topics.title: Fortune Ops and Cookie Pushes
topics.summary: The broadcast centers around callers discussing their experiences with ‘Fortune Ops,’ an affordable jewelry store, and the tradition of giving mothers a 'cookie push’ (a Carvel ice cream cake) for Mother's Day. The conversation becomes increasingly absurd involving fabricated scenarios, personal insults, and references to Tom Carvel.

topics.title: Cookie Puss and Hewlett Packard
topics.summary: A chaotic radio segment features impressions of David Brennan and bizarre cake ideas (including a ‘vagina’ cake), shouting at colleagues, and debating Mother's Day gifts like fax machines from Hewlett Packard. The hosts engage in heated arguments about the merits of various cakes while expressing frustration with each other’s behavior during a writing meeting.

topics.title: Uncomfortable ‘Guess Who’ Game with Racial Undertones
topics.summary: A chaotic radio segment features a caller, Kurt Waldheim Jr., attempting the game 'Guess Who?' using increasingly bizarre categories including actresses. The conversation quickly devolves into offensive and antisemitic accusations regarding ancestry, CD prizes, and disturbing references to sexualized imagery, revealing deeply inappropriate and unfounded claims.”} 29 words

topics.title: CD Player Arguments & Listener Calls
topics.summary: A man argues with his wife over a CD player prize featuring explicit images, while listeners offer unsolicited advice ranging from comparisons to her mother to business ideas like selling hot dogs. The conversation quickly devolves into personal criticisms and bizarre suggestions.

topics.title: Yankees Trade, Burger King Kids & McMahon’s Latest
topics.summary: The Yankees traded a player due to disagreements with Steinbrenner. The radio host discusses baseball stats, entertains Burger King kids while addressing sound system issues and reminiscing about past embarrassing encounters, alongside Ed McMahon's continued pursuit of Diana Christie despite her reluctance.

topics.title: Stern’s Public Cuddles with Diana
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, Howard Stern discusses his public cuddling incident with Ed Diana, detailing how he kissed her cheek after she was leaned on by him. The conversation includes speculation about Omar Sharif and an awkward discussion of underwear mishaps and financial woes, culminating in a phone call from the actor Bernie Goldberg.
